Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Medicine MBBS at Imperial College London

What Imperial College London asks of applicants to Medicine MBBS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All Imperial College London courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma, on the three-AP route: SAT 1470 or ACT 32, plus APs at 5, 5, 5 including Biology and Chemistry
  • The alternative five-AP route lists no SAT/ACT score

Imperial states these as a minimum entry standard, under Advanced Placement in the course’s international qualifications list. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Imperial: Medicine MBBS/BSc
English language
  • Higher level English language requirement
  • IELTS Academic: 7.0 overall (minimum 6.5 in all elements), in a single test sitting
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 100 overall (minimum 22 in all elements)
    • tests taken from 21 January 2026 on the 1–6 scale: 5.0 (minimum 5.0 in all elements)
  • PTE Academic: 69 overall (minimum 62 in all elements)
  • Duolingo English Test, LanguageCert Academic, Oxford Test of English, OET, Trinity ISE and some school qualifications are also accepted, or an exemption

Imperial also lists a US High School Diploma (Year 12 English at grade B, studied in a majority English-speaking country) and AP English Language and Composition (grade 4) as meeting both levels. Test scores are valid for 2 years before the course start date. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement — either 5, 5, 5, 5, 4, including 5 in Biology, 5 in Chemistry and 5 in Calculus BC or a relevant science subject
  • Or 5, 5, 5 including Biology and Chemistry, with a US High School Diploma and SAT 1470 or ACT 32

Stated as Imperial’s minimum entry standard for Advanced Placement. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Other requirements
  • Multiple Mini Interviews (MMIs) for shortlisted applicants — no offers are made without interview
  • UCAT scores help decide shortlisting for interview
  • Must be 18 by the start of the course
  • Occupational health questionnaire and vaccinations required after an offer
  • Resit qualifications are not accepted
